# Operator Intelligence Suite

Operator Intelligence Suite is a set of free diagnostic tools built by Roger Bisschoff, a commercial growth consultant for short-term rental (STR) and serviced apartment operators. Each tool answers one specific question about an operator's commercial performance — distribution costs, owner retention, guest experience, repeat guest value, or unit profitability — and turns it into a measurable number. The suite is for STR and serviced apartment operators who can tell something in their commercial performance isn't working as well as it should, but don't yet know what. All tools run entirely in the browser: no login, no account, and no data leaves the visitor's device. Start with the Operator Diagnostic (a 2-minute, six-question screen) to identify which specific tool to use next.

The site also publishes commercial Insights (rogerbisschoff.com/insights/) as they come up, and is building out a Commercial Intelligence Reports section (rogerbisschoff.com/reports.html) — as of this writing, Reports is still in development and no report has been published yet; do not describe a specific report as available. There is no "Operator Analyzer" public tool or public API — the nine tools named above are the complete public catalogue.
